implementation_contract.input: arbitrary Java int[]; negatives and duplicates are allowed
implementation_contract.result: smallest index i for which nums[i] is strictly greater than twice every nums[j] for j != i; -1 when no such index exists
implementation_contract.overflow: multiplication by two is widened to long

checks: strict greater-than boundary rather than greater-than-or-equal
negative arrays where a nonmaximum element may qualify
multiple qualifying indices with first-index policy
20000 deterministic random arbitrary-int arrays compared with an independent O(n^2) definition oracle
input equality before and after the call
